conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described denial-of-service compilation issue affects versions < 1.5.5, and is not present starting with this version.
summary: The rust-lang regex crate before 1.5.5 did not properly limit compiled regex complexity: a pattern like (?:){294967295} compiles the empty sub-expression many times; empty sub-expressions use no memory, so the size-limit machinery never triggered, causing DoS when parsing untrusted regex patterns (CVE-2022-24713, GHSA-m5pq-gvj9-9vr8). Only affects programs compiling untrusted patterns. Fixed in 1.5.5 (src/compile.rs) by counting repetitions on zero-cost sub-expressions during size estimation.
